errors.too-many-files: The skill has too many files. Remove unrelated files and generate again.

errors.not-found: The skill or package no longer exists. Refresh the list and retry.
errors.package-changed: The package has been replaced. Refresh before trying again.
errors.rejected: The package operation was rejected. Check the source files and package authorization, then retry.
errors.unavailable: The package service is unavailable. Check the local service and retry.

errors.listFailed: Could not load the package list. Refresh and try again.
